name: 304不锈钢实心起重卸扣款
description: 实心铸造承重强，304耐腐防锈，D型弓形双款规格齐全

styleLock.backgroundSystem: mist blue-grey page background #DCE3EF with porcelain white rounded cards #FFFFFF and deep navy banner panels #2B4C7E; sections alternate light backgrounds to keep rhythm
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft neutral-cool studio light, front-top key, soft contact shadow, gentle controlled reflections on brushed steel; flat even lighting on infographic screens
styleLock.surfaceSystem: white marble slab podiums, matte white geometric platforms (diamond slab, cylinder) and clean seamless studio floors
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; small English eyebrow labels above bold navy #2B4C7E Chinese headlines; short grey body lines; brushed gold #C9A063 reserved for highlight characters, tips and notice accents; all in-image Chinese wrapped in 「」
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line flat navy icons inside small outlined frames; numbered outline badges with a tiny wave motif
styleLock.presentationRules: shackles rendered clean and polished, centered on minimal geometric display platforms; stable slightly-low front 3/4 hero angle across product shots; consistent product scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent industrial-premium ecommerce detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mist blue-grey page background #DCE3EF, porcelain white rounded cards #FFFFFF, deep navy headlines and banners #2B4C7E, coral-red pill labels #EF6A5E as primary accent, brushed gold #C9A063 as secondary accent for highlight characters, tips and notice banners; neutral-cool soft studio lighting; modern geometric sans-serif typography with small English eyebrow labels above bold Chinese headlines; rounded-corner cards composed as complete balanced layouts with natural breathing margins; thin-line flat navy icons; product rendered as clean polished stainless steel on minimal geometric display platforms; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 首屏建立产品身份与第一卖点，一眼赢取继续阅读

shots.props: soft green leaves entering the top corners, two small white spheres on the platform
shots.textZone: top 35%: centered rounded pill badge, bold headline, lighter subtitle, then one thin divider row with four short words
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Hero opening screen: {product} shown as two standing shackle forms on a white marble slab podium, photographed from a slightly low front 3/4 angle. Bright soft neutral-cool studio light from the front top, soft contact shadow grounding the products, gentle brushed-steel reflections. Mist blue-grey background #DCE3EF fading to white #FFFFFF, white marble podium. Props: soft green leaves entering the top corners, two small white spheres on the platform. Products fill 60-70% of the frame as the dominant anchor, the podium and top text field completing one balanced composition. Top text zone: small rounded navy #2B4C7E pill reading 「{selling_point_1}」, large bold navy headline 「{callout_1}」, lighter subtitle 「{callout_2}」, and one thin divider row with four short selling words 「{selling_point_2}」. 2K commercial detail-page quality. provenance.notes: 源为13片切分的详情页长图（800×1200/片，相邻重叠60px），主产品经识图确认为304不锈钢起重卸扣（D型+弓形双款），与文件名一致。已剥离：品牌『90』徽标与角标、英文装饰句、图库水印、会员二维码贴片、联系/批发/发货话术、搜索引述及全部具体规格数值（以 {callout_n} 文案槽位由使用方填写）。与库内 suite-jiazhuangdengju-304buxiugangjiaolian（304不锈钢液压缓冲铰链）同属家装灯具/五金，leaf 与定位不同：本模版为起重索具卸扣详情页。源图部分展示台/棋盘格图框内未见产品实体（疑似长图模板残留框），对应镜位已按通用产品特写重建。
